title: North-South Commuter Railway full operations moved to Q3 of 2033

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The scheduled full operation of the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) has been moved from 2032 to 2033 due to cost-cutting measures of the government, Palace press officer Claire Castro announced on Thursday. She said the adjustment was approved by the Economy and Development Council (EDC), chaired by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., during Wednesday afternoon’s meeting in Malacañang. “Nagkaroon ng kaunting pagbabago tungkol sa timeline, dahil alam naman natin na nagkaroon ng medyo pagtitipid, mag-iingat sa pondo ng bayan at nahirapan sa mga procurements and maliban pa diyan ay nagkakaroon ding isyu sa right of way,” Castro said in a briefing.
